points.text: DIPS AS is registered as aksjeselskap (AS) based in Bodø, registered under 'Konsulentvirksomhet tilknyttet informasjonsteknologi og forvaltning og drift av it-systemer', founded 1997-12-01.
What it does (per its website): DIPS utvikler helseteknologi og skaper løsninger for helsepersonell i norske sykehus og kommuner.
Latest filed accounts (2025): revenue 790.4M NOK, operating result 192.6M, net result 164.0M; revenue up 15% vs 2024 (calculated).
Leadership: Daglig leder: Thomas Smedsrud; Styrets leder: Arve Ree.
6 registered workplace(s): Bergen, Bodø, Oslo, Sunnfjord, Tromsø, Trondheim.
Verified website: https://www.dips.com/ (exact legal name plus registry phone/address on site).
Company-linked profiles: linkedin, youtube, instagram, facebook.
Recent official register changes: 2026-10-14 registered employees; 2026-09-15 registered employees; 2026-08-13 registered employees.
